title: The Sphere Packing Problem in Dimension 4 and the Twenty-Four-Cell Conjecture
description: This revision combines the certificate results in merge #40 with the protected-shell volume estimates. Condition (C) is proved for 28 or more nearby centres and specified 27-centre sectors. The 25- and 26-centre cases and the remaining 27-centre cases of (C), and the unrestricted case of (G), remain open.
